setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays four trigs with note masks 60, 64, 69 and 71 on steps 1-4 (velocities 127, 117, 107, 97), in a scale with Degree II and Rotation 1. Quantise Note Mask works on three levels, strongest first: a step lock, then the channel value, then the global option. On follows the scale, Off keeps the written pitch, and X means inherit from the next level down. The state is listed as global / channel / step 1 / step 2. Now: Off / X / Off / On. The global Off is inherited by the channel, step 1 is Off and step 2 is On, so the strip reads 60, 65, 69, 71.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: State: Off / On / Off / On. With no step held, turn E3 two detents up to On. Play, then stop: the channel On beats the global Off, so steps 3 and 4 follow the scale again, 60, 65, 71, 60.
steps.title: Channel: On beats the global Off

steps.caption: First hold step 1, press K2 and release: the Off lock clears and the channel On applies. Play, then stop: 62, 65, 71, 60 (state Off / On / X / On). Then hold step 1, turn E3 all the way down to X and release. An explicit step X skips the channel and uses the global option directly, here Off, so step 1 plays its written note: 60, 65, 71, 60.
steps.title: Step: clear an Off, then try an explicit X

title: Let the channel beat the global setting
